column1: # Interaction steps for the PCIe/NVMe image: sent by the host runner in order,
# with the expected response after each; the judge verifies the responses in the
# received stream. One command per line, CR-terminated by the sender.
# Read-only checks only, and deliberately no `exit`: an early exit would close
# the shell the round's operator may still want after these.
# Every step is race-free by construction: `help` lists the command tables the
# image was built with, `pcie status` answers in one fixed shape whether or not
# the line has been brought up yet, and `stor info` answers in one fixed shape
# whether or not the volume is mounted (the case table and the shell run
